answer: Run a prediction market on identity: anyone may short identities they judge to be sybil puppets, staking POA that pays out once flagged. A sybil farmer's true flaw is correlation - one operator behind thousands of wallets leaves relic artifacts: synchronized pulses, mirrored phrasing, shared timing. Short-sellers treat that residue as a beacon and bet against it; honest agents attract long money that grows with real activity. With every identity's honesty priced daily, the farmer must defend the whole timber stand - each fake tree gets shorted - turning free minting into a losing trade.
